id: 03_Safety Quiz on National Safety Day Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For Safet
title: 某国安全日知识竞赛
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/03_Safety Quiz on National Safety Day Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For Safet.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/03_Safety Quiz on National Safety Day Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For Safet/src.py

points.K2: 印度安全理事会何时成立
points.K3: 印度国家安全日是哪天

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，背景是地球和握在一起的手的图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium in front of a globe icon held up by many hands and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天的问答，讲讲别国的安全日。
overlay: 安全日问答：别国的安全日和我们的安全月

shots.scene: 日历图标，三月初的一天被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A blank calendar with one day in early March circled. No text. No people.
shots.narration: 十道选择题，先想再看答案。

shots.scene: 阿杰在大厅看到一张空白的安全日海报，好奇地看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks curiously at a blank safety day poster in a building lobby.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：国家安全日是哪天定的？

shots.scene: 小研笑着拿出一张空白问答卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and holds up a blank quiz card.
shots.narration: 小研说：答完这十道题就知道。

shots.scene: 问答台上十张空白题卡排开
shots.prompt_en: Ten blank question cards laid out in a row on the quiz podium. No people.
shots.narration: 印度国家安全日，一共十道题。

shots.scene: 阿杰托腮思考，头顶倒计时图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student thinks with his chin in his hand; a countdown timer icon above his head.
shots.narration: 每题先想一想，再公布答案。

shots.section_title: 印度安全理事会何时成立
shots.scene: 一座建筑图标，屋顶飘着空白旗子，旁边日历
shots.prompt_en: A building icon with a blank flag on the roof next to a blank calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：印度国家安全理事会何时成立？
overlay: 印度安全理事会何时成立

shots.section_title: 印度安全理事会何时成立
shots.scene: 日历翻到三月四日
shots.prompt_en: A blank calendar flips to early March. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，一九六六年三月四日。

shots.section_title: 印度国家安全日是哪天
shots.scene: 一面空白旗子升起，周围有人鼓掌的图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank flag being raised on a pole with clapping hands icons around it. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：哪一天定为国家安全日？
overlay: 印度国家安全日是哪天

shots.section_title: 印度国家安全日是哪天
shots.scene: 日历同一天被圈出
shots.prompt_en: The same day on the calendar is circled with a festive ribbon. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，一九七二年起每年三月四日。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一块空白牌子，三个图标：握手、种子长成树、灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank board with three icons: a handshake, a seedling growing into a tree and a light bulb.
shots.narration: 第三题：设立安全日为了什么？

shots.scene: 老板和员工两个人形图标一起举手宣誓
shots.prompt_en: Two figure icons, an employer and an employee, raise their hands together as if making a promise. No people.
shots.narration: 提醒单位和员工，履行安全责任和承诺。

shots.scene: 一棵树的根伸进工厂、办公室、学校各种建筑
shots.prompt_en: A tree whose roots spread under a factory, an office, a school and a small shop. No people.
shots.narration: 让安全文化扎根各行各业。

shots.scene: 实验室、办公室这些没有危险图标的建筑也被树根连上
shots.prompt_en: The roots also reach a quiet office and a laboratory building without hazard icons. No people.
shots.narration: 不只危险行业，法规没覆盖的地方也要。

shots.scene: 灯泡亮起，事故图标被挡在盾牌外
shots.prompt_en: A light bulb lights up while an accident icon bounces off a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 提高安全意识，避免意外事故。

shots.scene: 三个图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three icons receive green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 三条都对，答案D，以上全部。

shots.scene: 三栋政府大楼图标，各插空白旗子
shots.prompt_en: Three government building icons, each with a blank flag. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：理事会是哪个部门设立的？

shots.scene: 有工人安全帽图标的大楼亮起
shots.prompt_en: The building with a hard hat icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，劳动部。

shots.scene: 两本空白法规书，一个登记印章盖在中间
shots.prompt_en: Two blank law books with a registration stamp pressed between them. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：理事会按什么法律登记？

shots.scene: 两本书都亮起，印章打勾
shots.prompt_en: Both books light up and the stamp shows a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 社团登记法和公共信托法，两者都是。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起两本空白法规书
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two blank law books side by side.
shots.narration: 答案C，按两部法律双重登记。

shots.scene: 地图轮廓上一个大圆点，代表全国
shots.prompt_en: A blank country map outline with one large dot in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：理事会在全国层面做什么？

shots.scene: 讲台、书本、柱状图三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a lecture podium, a stack of blank booklets and a bar chart. No people.
shots.narration: 办研讨会，出安全资料，发布统计数据。

shots.scene: 三个图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three icons get green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，以上全部。

shots.scene: 地图上几个小圆点，代表各地
shots.prompt_en: The country map outline with several small dots across regions. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：在地方层面做什么？

shots.scene: 不同颜色的对话气泡、海报、小册子图标
shots.prompt_en: Speech bubbles in different colors, blank posters and small blank booklets. No people.
shots.narration: 用当地语言办活动、发海报、印手册。

shots.scene: 手册打开，里面是打勾的好做法图标
shots.prompt_en: An open blank booklet showing icons of good practices with check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 手册里是最佳安全做法，答案D。

shots.scene: 一座工厂图标，门口站着几名员工
shots.prompt_en: A factory gate with a few workers gathered at the entrance.
shots.narration: 第八题：在企业层面做什么？

shots.scene: 员工举手宣誓，手里拿着空白誓词卡
shots.prompt_en: Workers raise their right hands holding blank pledge cards.
shots.narration: 编写和分发安全誓词，大家一起宣誓。

shots.scene: 升起一面空白旗帜
shots.prompt_en: A blank flag is raised on a pole at the factory yard.
shots.narration: 升起安全日的旗帜。

shots.scene: 展板和抢答台的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of blank exhibition boards and a quiz buzzer. No people.
shots.narration: 办安全竞赛和展览，答案D全部。

shots.scene: 一座灯塔，光照向工厂、办公室、绿树
shots.prompt_en: A lighthouse shining its light toward a factory, an office and green trees. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：理事会的愿景是什么？

shots.scene: 三个图标：盾牌、心形、绿叶
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a shield, a heart and a green leaf. No people.
shots.narration: 提供指导和服务，让工作场所更安全、

shots.scene: 心形和绿叶亮起
shots.prompt_en: The heart and the leaf icons glow. No people.
shots.narration: 更健康、更环保，做全国的领先者。

shots.scene: 一个会议桌图标，周围不同国家的小旗（空白）
shots.prompt_en: A round conference table icon surrounded by small blank flags. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：它办过几次国际会议？

shots.scene: 五根手指的手势图标
shots.prompt_en: A hand icon showing five fingers. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，五次。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在日历和地球之间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a calendar and a globe.
shots.narration: 回顾一下今天的问答。

shots.prompt_en: Two blank calendars side by side, both with an early March day circled. No people.
shots.narration: 1966年成立，1972年起办安全日。

shots.scene: 握手、树根、灯泡三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a handshake, spreading tree roots and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 安全日的目的：责任、文化、意识。

shots.scene: 全国、地方、企业三层图标
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked icons: a country map, regional dots and a factory gate. No people.
shots.narration: 全国、地方、企业，三个层面都有活动。

shots.scene: 阿杰在答题卡上打满勾，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up an answer card full of green ticks and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：十道题，我全记住了。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside the quiz podium.
shots.narration: 安全日问答到这里，下次见！
